authorization: User requests all proposed next steps on 2026-09-07; public data, preparation and simulated observation only.
amendment: Previous v2 protocol required complete readiness before prospective activation. This separate protocol permits a bounded observation pilot while those gates remain unresolved; it does not activate executable paper trading, formal Proof, promotion or capital. Record hypothetical selections and later price marks, even when readiness fails, without claiming investability or fills.
model: Unchanged v2 payoff_summary and training-only kNN200 geometry, 8 delayed features, fixed repaired 2021-2023 training observations including censored cases. No historical evaluation, refit, parameter search or tuning from this pilot.
universe: Original deterministic 240-symbol sample, intersect current public exchangeInfo TRADING and spot permission. Original stable/fiat exclusions plus RLUSD and explicit legacy leveraged-family helper. No replacements, no new coins selected after seeing results. This corrects a known category error prospectively only; original training and evidence remain unchanged. JUP and SYRUP are not excluded by a generic suffix, but are not added to the original sample.
feature_contract: Monday 00 UTC anchor; exactly 90 consecutive positive complete daily bars ending Saturday. Use extract_features with the same full-day delay. Actual source retrieval known_at must precede committed decision. Live acquisition finishes within entry window; otherwise record MISSED, never backdate or use a Monday open after observing later prices.
selection: Require at least 10 eligible samples; rank strictly positive fixed payoff scores, symbol tie-break, at most five with 20% initial research weight each. Unused allocation is zero-yield USDT reference cash. Preserve both qualified model candidates and final selections. No purchase instruction.
entry_mark: Commit decision to a hash-linked local append-only ledger and fsync it BEFORE requesting any entry book. Then record read-only public depth ask VWAP for 1000 USDT gross simulated notional per candidate. No actual fills. Quote age is bounded by request round trip and request time only; REST book has no per-level timestamp. Fail on slow requests, insufficient visible depth or invalid prices. Also record BTC and equal-weight contemporaneous eligible basket as separate reference marks at the same run, not synchronized fills.
outcome: Due at the next Monday 00 UTC, allowing up to 60 minutes for actual retrieval. Fetch exit depth and use bid VWAP for the recorded quantity. Never choose a price retroactively. If entry or due observation is missed, suspended, unpriced, or outside the window, censor the affected outcome. Keep its weight and reason. No symbol migration is assumed without a separately recorded official identity event. An unresolved component makes the portfolio return null; never silently renormalize survivors.

costs.book_cost: Spread and displayed depth impact measured only at observation; additional slippage scenarios do not relabel them as actual realized costs.

events: Save complete current public exchangeInfo response, diffs against prior observation and attempts to retrieve official delisting/update announcements with observed known_at. A successful page is not evidence of complete event coverage. Public event-feed completeness remains UNKNOWN unless separately audited. Missing notices block executable readiness, not read-only observation. Historical BTT/CVP/VIDT remain censored until an exact-horizon exit is verified.
economic_reference: User venue and attainable benchmark requested but unknown at registration. Existing dated BRL/Selic scenario is conditional. USDT cash is not BRL risk-free cash; report FX separately. Research marks remain USDT until a verified user conversion/benchmark route is available.
evidence: Twelve entry slots test operation and generate genuinely new observations. This is not a profitability proof horizon. Publish a normal-design power sensitivity grid, explicitly conditional on unmeasured paired weekly dispersion and dependence. No formal model-specific Core attestation or G1-G7 pass may be inferred from unit tests or synthetic checks.
stopping_rule: Do not change the model when it abstains or loses. No significance testing during the 12 slots; report descriptive marks and missingness. After last due slot stop the recurring pilot and report feasibility, candidates, costs and unresolved gates. Operational bug fixes must be versioned before later decisions; preserve all prior ledger records.
scheduler: Codex task heartbeat at weekly Monday 00 UTC (Sunday 21 America/Sao_Paulo), through final due slot. Local app and PC must be running; missed slots remain missed. Quiet unless meaningful change, completion, failure or required user action.

registration_amendments.change: Only the verified known RLUSD category error is excluded additionally. Do not classify symbols such as U from their ticker alone. No addition/removal based on returns.

mark_fee_accounting: For a hypothetical 1000 USDT budget, consume displayed asks; deduct assumed 10bps buy fee from acquired base quantity. Additional slippage stresses are quantity haircuts. Exit consumes displayed bids and deducts assumed 10bps sell fee and the extra slippage haircut from quote proceeds. Daily v2 neighbor-score cost algebra remains frozen; book-mark accounting is a distinct declared observation proxy. Lot-size rounding, account restrictions and tax are not certified.
synthetic_control_plan: Seed 20260907: fixed 1600-observation two-cluster kNN200 positive/negative geometry control over 80 weeks, one censored-neighbor guard, 100 stipulated zero-log-drift week-common-shock replicates (two candidate queries each). Report qualification count without interpreting it as general null calibration. Conditional power grid: extra 5/10/20 annual percentage points over dated 11.3177% scenario, weekly paired log SD 1/3/5%, dependence multipliers 1/4, two-sided alpha 5%, power 80%. No observed market return feeds this grid.
